import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static class Node {
        int nxt, t, c, l;
        Node(int nxt, int t, int c, int l) {
            this.nxt = nxt;
            this.t = t;
            this.c = c;
            this.l = l;
        }
    }
    static class Data {
        int f, t;
        Data(int f, int t) {
            this.f = f;
            this.t = t;
        }
    }
    static List<Node> G = new ArrayList<>();
    static int tot;
    static int[] pre, pos, f, d;
    static boolean[] vis;
    static Queue<Integer> que = new LinkedList<>();
    static int S, T;
    static int n, m, k, C, D;
    static int[][] p, cnt;
    static Data[] s;

    static int F(int x, int y) {
        return x * n + y;
    }

    static int addEdge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
        G.add(new Node(from, to, cap, cost)); // forward edge at index tot
        G.add(new Node(to, from, 0, -cost)); // reverse edge at tot+1
        tot += 2;
        return tot - 2; // index of forward edge
    }

    static int spfa() {
        int maxNode = T + 2;
        for (int i = 1; i <= T; i++) {
            d[i] = INF;
            f[i] = 0;
        }
        f[S] = INF;
        d[S] = 0;
        que.clear();
        que.add(S);
        vis[S] = true;
        while (!que.isEmpty()) {
            int u = que.poll();
            vis[u] = false;
            for (int i = G.get(u).nxt; i != 0; i = G.get(i).nxt) {
                Node e = G.get(i);
                int v = e.t;
                if (e.c > 0 && d[v] > d[u] + e.l) {
                    d[v] = d[u] + e.l;
                    f[v] = Math.min(f[u], e.c);
                    pos[v] = i;
                    pre[v] = u;
                    if (!vis[v]) {
                        vis[v] = true;
                        que.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return f[T];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        C = sc.nextInt();
        D = sc.nextInt();
        S = F(n + k, n) + 1;
        T = S + 2;

        int maxNode = n * (n + k + 1) + 10;
        pre = new int[maxNode];
        pos = new int[maxNode];
        f = new int[maxNode];
        d = new int[maxNode];
        vis = new boolean[maxNode];

        G.add(new Node(0, 0, 0, 0)); // dummy index 0
        int tot = 1; // we'll start adding from index 1
        // Actually we need to manage tot manually; we set tot = 1 initially.
        // But addEdge increments by 2. We'll make tot a global static variable.
        Main.tot = 1; // start from 1 to mimic C++

        // Re-assign G: we need to use the static tot. So we'll create a new ArrayList? Already done.
        // We'll just use the static method.

        // But we need to implement addEdge to use static tot. We'll define it as above.
        // However, we already defined addEdge, but it uses G and tot. We'll set tot=1 before calls.

        // Add edges
        addEdge(S, F(0, 1), INF, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(S, F(0, x), 1, 0);
        }

        s = new Data[2 * m + 2];
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            int b = sc.nextInt();
            s[2 * i] = new Data(a, b);
            s[2 * i - 1] = new Data(b, a);
        }
        m *= 2;

        int maxT = n + Math.max(k, n) + 2;
        p = new int[maxT][2 * m + 2];
        cnt = new int[maxT][2 * m + 2];
        // Initialize cnt to 1 where needed later, but we'll set only when adding edges.

        for (int t = 1; t <= n + k; t++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                addEdge(F(t - 1, i), F(t, i), INF, 0);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                int idx = addEdge(F(t - 1, s[i].f), F(t, s[i].t), 1, D);
                p[t][i] = idx;
                cnt[t][i] = 1;
            }
            addEdge(F(t, 1), T, INF, t * C);
        }

        int flow, ans = 0;
        while ((flow = spfa()) != 0) {
            int u = T;
            while (u != S) {
                int v = pre[u];
                Node e = G.get(pos[u]);
                e.c -= flow;
                Node rev = G.get(pos[u] ^ 1);
                rev.c += flow;
                u = v;
            }
            ans += d[T] * flow;
            for (int t = 1; t <= n + n; t++) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                    if (G.get(p[t][i]).c > 0) {
                        cnt[t][i]++;
                        int newIdx = addEdge(F(t - 1, s[i].f), F(t, s[i].t), 1, D * (cnt[t][i] * 2 - 1));
                        p[t][i] = newIdx;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
